entries.title: Acts 22:1
segments: "Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make in your presence."

entries.title: Acts 22:2
segments: When they heard him speaking in Hebrew they became the more quiet.

entries.title: Acts 22:3
segments: "I am a Jew," he said, "born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, taught according to the strict manner of the Law of our forefathers, ardent for God, even as you all are this day.

entries.title: Acts 22:4
segments: "I persecuted to the death this way, continually binding and delivering up to prisons both men and women.

entries.title: Acts 22:5
segments: "To this the high priest and all the council of elders are witnesses. It was from them that I received letters to the brothers in Damascus, and I was already on my way to bring those also who were there back to Jerusalem, in bonds, for punishment.

entries.title: Acts 22:6
segments: "But when, on my journey, I was nearing Damascus, about noon, suddenly a great light from heaven shone round about me.

entries.title: Acts 22:7
segments: "I fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to me, "`Saul! Saul! why are you persecuting me?'

entries.title: Acts 22:8
segments: "`Who are you, Lord?' I asked. "`I am Jesus, the Nazarene, whom you are persecuting,' he answered me.

entries.title: Acts 22:9
segments: "Now my companions, though they beheld the light, did not hear the words of Him who spoke to me.

entries.title: Acts 22:10
segments: "And I said, `What shall I do, Lord?' and the Lord said to me, `Rise and go into Damascus, and there you will be told about all that you are destined to do.'

entries.title: Acts 22:11
segments: "And as I was seeing nothing for the glory of the light, I was led by the hand of my companions, and so came into Damascus.

entries.title: Acts 22:12
segments: "And a certain Ananias, a pious man according to the Law, well thought of by all the Jews who lived there,

entries.title: Acts 22:13
segments: "came to me, and standing by me, said to me, "`Brother Saul, receive your sight' "In that very hour I regained my sight and looked up at him.

entries.title: Acts 22:14
segments: "Then he said: "`The God of our forefathers has appointed you to know his will; and to see the righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

entries.title: Acts 22:15
segments: "`For before the face of all men you will be a witness for him of what you have seen and heard.

entries.title: Acts 22:16
segments: "`And now why do you wait? Rise and be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling upon his name.'

entries.title: Acts 22:17
segments: "After my return to Jerusalem, and while I was praying in the temple,

entries.title: Acts 22:18
segments: "I fell into a trance and saw him saying to me, "`Make haste and go quickly out of Jerusalem, because they will not receive your testimony concerning me.'

entries.title: Acts 22:19
segments: "`Lord,' I replied, `they themselves well know that I was beating and imprisoning in synagogue after synagogue those who believed in you,

entries.title: Acts 22:20
segments: "`and when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by and consenting, and holding the garments of his murders.'

entries.title: Acts 22:21
segments: "`Depart,' he said to me, `for I will send you forth, far hence, to the Gentiles.'"

entries.title: Acts 22:22
segments: Until they heard this last statement, the people were listening to Paul, but now they roared out: "Away with such a fellow from the earth! He is not fit to live!"

entries.title: Acts 22:23
segments: When they continued to shout, throwing their clothes into the air, and flinging dust around,

entries.title: Acts 22:24
segments: the tribune ordered him to be brought into the barracks, and examined under the lash, to learn for what reason the people were thus crying out against him.

entries.title: Acts 22:25
segments: But when they had tied him up with the thongs, Paul said to the centurion who was standing near, "If a man is a Roman citizen, and uncondemned, is it lawful for you to scourge him?"

entries.title: Acts 22:26
segments: When the centurion heard that, he went to the tribune and said to him: "What are you intending to do? This man is a Roman citizen."

entries.title: Acts 22:27
segments: So the tribune came to Paul and asked him, "Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?" "Yes," he said.

entries.title: Acts 22:28
segments: "I paid a large sum to get this citizenship," said the tribune. "But I was citizen-born," said Paul.

entries.title: Acts 22:29
segments: Then those who were about to scourge him, immediately left him. And the tribune too, was afraid, when he learned that Paul was a Roman citizen, for he had had him bound.

entries.title: Acts 22:30
segments: The next day, as he wished to learn the real reason why the Jews accused Paul, he unbound him, and commanded the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin to come together, and brought Paul down, and placed him before them.
